expectationSemantics: Schema v2 is a bounded static CI guard for recognized direct/static HTTP constructors in long-running product service processes and exact reviewed executor transportAdapter bindings; it validates logical-operation graph metadata and freezes explicitly named legacy direct sinks as migration debt. It is not whole-program JavaScript dataflow analysis; approved transports and sanctioned injection callers remain part of the in-process trusted computing base. Product CLI and maintenance-script egress is outside this registry and must be reviewed separately.

canonical.loopback-control.purpose: Call a product-owned loopback control endpoint whose authority is fixed by the running service.

canonical.public-model-metadata.purpose: Read public model-family metadata from a fixed upstream catalog authority.

configured.external-observation.purpose: Read liveness or inventory metadata from an explicitly configured optional external endpoint.

configured.ollama-inference.purpose: Submit a bounded non-streaming model request to an Ollama authority selected from product configuration.

configured.ollama-lifecycle.purpose: Observe or change model residency and model artifacts on an Ollama authority selected from product configuration.

configured.ollama-observation.purpose: Read Ollama inventory, version, model metadata, or residency from a configured authority.

configured.ollama-stream.purpose: Stream model output from an Ollama authority selected from product configuration.

configured.product-inference.purpose: Submit inference or inference-contract work to a configured Agent X product service.

configured.product-observation.purpose: Read health, inventory, status, or evidence from a configured Agent X product service.

configured.product-recovery.purpose: Transfer recovery control data or a snapshot through the configured RAG service boundary.

configured.product-telemetry.purpose: Deliver a bounded product event to the configured Core service.

configured.product-transport.purpose: Execute a bounded request through the configured product-service transport helper.

configured.qdrant-observation.purpose: Read liveness metadata from the configured internal Qdrant dependency.

configured.qdrant-data.purpose: Execute bounded RAG collection and point operations against the configured internal Qdrant dependency.

configured.search-provider.purpose: Send a user search query to the explicitly configured search provider and read bounded results.

configured.worker-ingest.purpose: Submit a worker-owned document ingest request to the configured local RAG API.

delegated.benchmark-transport.purpose: Execute a Benchmark HTTP request after the calling workflow has resolved or admitted its target authority.

request-admitted.cloud-inference.purpose: Read provider metadata or submit inference to a cloud authority admitted by an approved cloud-lane configuration.

request-admitted.extension.purpose: Call a separately deployed trusted extension only after its URL and capability contract have been admitted.

request-admitted.ollama-inference.purpose: Submit inference to an Ollama authority selected through a caller-facing admission boundary.

request-admitted.ollama-lifecycle.purpose: Observe or change model residency and artifacts after the caller-selected Ollama authority is admitted.

request-admitted.ollama-observation.purpose: Read Ollama inventory or model metadata after the caller-selected authority is admitted.
